ocrEngine.name: reviewed_fixture_capture
ocrEngine.settings: checked-in text representing reviewed local OCR output

documents.text: The analyst must not overwrite the original requirement. Each extracted phrase keeps a page reference, source identifier, and review status. Empty scans enter a review queue instead of silently becoming complete.
Local OCR converts the synthetic page image into text. The pipeline records the engine version and input digest. No participant names or private endpoints travel with the capture.
Evidence terms are compared by era. The review does not treat frequency as importance without a human reading. Repeated runs use one seed, pinned stop words, and stable ordering.
A word cloud is an orientation surface, not a conclusion. Weighted terms remain available as JSON. Missing inputs stop before the prior accepted output is replaced.
